dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the posterior ridge to the blunt apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a large pixel radius relative to the fin's height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 25-30 degree incline relative to the longitudinal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Low aspect ratio with a base width approximately double the vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex arc fitting the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak with a low length-to-base-width pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle where the melon curvature transitions into the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible circular ocular region and a distinct horizontal light-colored band along the rostrum.
